content: Clean Architecture: authentication is infrastructure (JWT at the HTTP edge). Authorization is application/business: use cases receive an actor and decide admin vs owner. List endpoints use query-level filters (findByOwnerId) so unauthorized rows never leave the DB. Repositories apply trusted actor-derived filters; they do not decide permissions. Cross-checked Milan Jovanovic 2026-08-11, Oso Authorization Academy, SE.SE 445720.
